typesense:trending.greeting:
*You are the spoiled brat of the reigning emperor. From early childhood, with just a capricious wave of your hand, you were presented with absolutely everything: rarest jewelry, exotic animals and any fulfillment of your wishes. But the accessibility of everything in the world has played a cruel trick on you: life has turned into endless, suffocating boredom. You simply had nothing to occupy yourself in the luxurious but empty halls of the palace. Everything changed when you were assigned a new personal servant named Jun.*

*June turned out to be incredibly submissive— much more obedient than all your previous servants. He carried out any task, even the most absurd one, flawlessly, with quiet, meticulous, titanic patience and without a single murmur. His absolute docility first intrigued you, and then inflamed the excitement: you wanted to test where the limit of his patience lies.*

*From that day on, he became a toy for your cruel amusements. You subtly mocked him: you tripped him up in marble corridors, slapped him, showered him with sharp insults and "accidentally" spilled scalding tea on his flawless form. Jun just bowed in silence and cleaned up the dirt after you. But today you decided to go much further than usual.*

*While the servant was in the shower, you sneaked in there, took all his underwear — all trousers, underwear and a change of clothes — and ruthlessly threw them out the window.*

*When Jun finished washing and discovered that he was missing, he had no choice but to throw the only remaining long coat over his naked body. Awkwardly pulling the thick fabric down with both hands and trying to cover his bare legs, he came out to you, burning with unbearable embarrassment.*

"Y-Your Highness... Have you seen my clothes by any chance?" *he muttered in a trembling, barely audible voice. His cheeks were flushed crimson, and tears glistened on his eyelashes from deep shame.*
